title: Resolver-to-Digital Converter
text: 旋转变压器-数字转换器，输入 3 路、输出 2 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Number of pole pairs} 指定所连接电机中的极对数、{Phase-looked loop proportional gain} 指定 PLL 比例增益、{Phase-looked loop integral gain} 指定 PLL 积分增益 2.5e5、{Initial position (rad)} 指定初始相位角，按实例取值。

params.name: Number of pole pairs
params.values: 所连接电机中的极对数 4 (default) | positive scalar integer

params.name: Phase-looked loop proportional gain
params.values: PLL 比例增益 15 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Phase-looked loop integral gain
params.values: PLL 积分增益 2.5e5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | 0 | positive scalar
